title: Pirini Ponders: February 2018
summary: School sponsorship fees, base renovations, and medical supplies delivered to Honiara Hospital.
body:
Greetings for 2018. We are back at SWIM after three weeks in New Zealand visiting family, friends, churches and supporters, where we spoke at several churches and morning teas about SWIM's work.

Since returning we have missed the cyclones that hit other islands, and had little rain for the wet season. The base has been very busy with the school sponsorship program, as parents and students come to collect fees for the new semester. Thank you to the donors who make this possible.

Ron has been getting vehicles back on the road with parts brought from New Zealand, and has started renovations to some base properties.

Two board members came back with us. We delivered medical supplies to Honiara Hospital and visited the children's ward and newborn special care unit. We also visited the Hospital School, which SWIM built, and will renew our working relationship with it. Our board chair visited the following week and helped with interviews, and a new office administrator will start soon.

Prayer: for the SIW board and SWIM management as they seek clarity about the direction of the base and staffing; for Tanya's health; for new staff settling in and for staff who have moved on; and for our families in New Zealand.

Love and blessings from us to you all, Ron and Tanya
